steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Those in SALVA are collecting corpses of the Corruptors and carrying out shady experiments in the hospital basement to gain the power of the Mania.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The medical director, Iron</color>, is crazy about developing various forbidden surgeries to distort the minds of the Syndicans with Mania to brainwash them.
...The rumors are true.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Don't make such a terrible face, ${PlayerName}. It's all over.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: No, he hasn't. He has been protecting himself very well, or perhaps this is just in his nature.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: He is so used to cruelty. It won't cause him mental contamination.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then give him to me. Don't dirty your hands over him.
What kind of ailment does this surgery treat?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: You're right. It's not Ted, but <color=#fb9259>Syndicate</color> who's ill.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Why harm people with Mania? Why crave filthy power? Why are there so many stupid gangsters like him?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Violence has infected the brains. This is the disease Syndicate suffers from. As long as they exist, Mania will never be contained.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: If you don't like it, why don't you teach me how to cure it?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Oh, I forgot... The <color=#fb9259>West District Order Management Regulations</color>... The city and you have given up on Syndicate long ago.
Iron looks down at you with narrowed, piercing eyes as chilling as metals.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Mania kills; I save. The authorities run away; I stay and cure it.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Now, you leave this mess behind but hold me accountable for my crime.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: What crime did I commit?
You thought she was the only sane one in the gangs. But now, that rational face only shows chilling rage and madness.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You've all been affected by Mania...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You said you hated Mania for distorting human hearts, but what you're doing is exactly the same.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Doctor, you're supposed to save lives. Don't let Mania warp your heart.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...I know what I'm doing. I'll bear all the consequences.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Stop looking down on people. Anne made her own choice. I warned you not to interfere.
She extends her mechanical arm with an extremely solemn look on her face—She is actually ready to fight you.
At this very moment, the motorcycles rumble from a distance and are getting closer.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This noise... It's that fleet.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The Legion is here? How did that happen?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It seems like what Ted said about SALVA working with the Legion is true.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, Suspect R has left. There's no point in staying here. We need to leave now.
You turn your gaze to Iron. The fire makes each scalpel in her hands look like it's soaked in blood. The doctor stands in the fire as if in hell.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'll let her off this time.

steps.content: You can't answer her question, but you do admire her dertermination. But if this continues, Mania will destroy these two.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, time is running out.

steps.speaker: Options-1
options: At least use the shackles on them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Forget about the shackles!! Get down!

Bang!
A pipe hits you at the back of your head hard, while the impact shatters the little remains of the hospital windows.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Carry ...Quick... There are cars outside...
You can feel yourself hanging, jolting in the air. Iron's shadow moves further away from you. You are thrown into a narrow space, and you can hear the vehicle engine starting.
Before your vision completely darkens, a modified motorcycle dashes out of the road into your sight.
A strong, sharp woman in a helmet is riding on the motorcycle. You can't make out her face—but you can see the heavy sword on her back clearly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Iron, I don't agree with what you guys do, but...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Syndicate needs doctors and cure.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you ever go too far, I'll come back and arrest you myself.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...Hehe, I hope you'll live to that day.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Go! There are cars outside!
Hella yanks you to run out of the hospital. Fire and destruction are everywhere outside the hospital, making the only intact pickup truck seem out of place.
A blonde driver is dozing off in the driver's seat. When he sees you approach, he jolts up. Before he manages to start the engine, he is strangled by Hella's pipe through the glass.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: Ugh…it's a misunderstanding. I'm just passing by. I'm just too sleepy that I dozed off.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who *** cares! Drive off!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hurry! The Legion is coming. Don't let them catch us!
At hearing these words, the blonde driver panics and presses his foot down on the gas.
Just after you leave, a modified motorcycle dashes out of the road and halts sharply in front of the hospital.
A strong, sharp woman in a helmet is riding on the motorcycle. You can't make out her face—but you can see the heavy sword on her back clearly.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ...don't dirty my hands...

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: In your opinion, are my hands dirty for doing this kind of surgery?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: A doctor who is supposed to save people ends up committing violence to hurt people... are her hands dirty as a result?
There is a hint of self-deprecating sadness in her words.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, it's not Ted, but Syndicate who's ill.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Why harm people with Mania? Why crave filthy power? Why are there so many stupid gangsters like him?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Violence has infected the brains. This is the disease Syndicate suffers from. As long as they exist, Mania will never be contained.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Tell me, ${PlayerName}, how do I heal Syndicate with clean hands?
But as you know, those who should be responsible has done nothing.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Yes. They enacted the West District Order Management Regulations and abandoned Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: So we made our own choices and assumed all the consequences.
She lifted her gaze. Her cold, metallic silver eyes are lit up with firelight, burning with determination, rage and madness.
At this very moment, you hear the approaching rumble of motorcycles from the distance.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This noise... It's that fleet.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The Legion is here? How did that happen?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ted said SALVA is connected with the Legion. Is it true?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: It's time to go, ${PlayerName}. You can't handle the people who are coming.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I will remember everything you've done for SALVA. You've already done more than enough. Nothing that happened in Syndicate was your fault. You don't belong here in the first place.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Don't sink any deeper. Don't become one of them. Don't be like me... you should be the one who keeps clean.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Go now. I'll buy you some time.
Iron gazes in the direction of the vehicles and stretches out her mechanical arms.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, Suspect R has left. There's no point in staying here. We need to leave now.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop wasting time! Go!
Hella yanks you to run out of the hospital. At the same time, a huge impact shatters what little remains of the hospital windows. Only Iron remains on the broken battlefield.
In your last glimpse of Iron, the fire makes each scalpel in her hand appear as if they are soaked in blood. She stands amidst a sea of flames, as if in the pit of hell.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There is a car over there!
Fire and destruction are ravaging everywhere outside the hospital, making the only intact pickup truck seem out of place.
